Name: No More Bowlegs Redux
Author: scorcher9009
Description:
This is a remake of the "No More Bowlegs" mods of yesteryear. Now made with Content Patcher, affecting more NPCs, and being updated to the current version of the game.


Most of the NPCs now have no gap between their legs, however, there are a few exceptions: When characters are sitting, and certain characters who have an odd number of sprites horizontally have a 1 pixel gap between their legs.


This mod currently affects all of the sprites for:
Abigail
Alex
Bouncer
Caroline
Clint
Demetrius
Dwarf
Elliott
Emily
Evelyn
femaleRival
Governor
Gunther
Gus
Haley
Harvey
Henchman
Jodi
Kent
Leah
Kel
Lewis
Linus
Marcello
Old Mariner
Marlon
Marnie
Maru
Morris
Leo
Sam
Sandy
Shane
Vincent
Willy


Compatibility: This will most likely not play well with mods that edit the affected sprites. I might make compatibility patches for certain mods I personally use(like Make Marlon Real).




All of the sprites used in this mod are modified from vanilla assets.
